hooks.text: Early space scientists feared the Moon was a deep, swallowing dust ocean.
The first lunar soft landing shattered fears of a swallowing dust ocean.
In 1966, a robotic lander proved the Moon was not liquid quicksand.

title: The Terrifying Myth of the Moon's Quicksand
description: Before Apollo 11, experts feared the Moon was a swallowing trap of deep dust. Probes proved the ground was solid, but the real hazard was levitating above it.

beats.text: Early space scientists feared the Moon was a deep, swallowing dust ocean.
beats.visual: Artist concept of a spacecraft sinking into deep lunar dust, 1965

beats.text: This theory suggested heavy landers would sink completely out of sight upon touchdown.
beats.visual: Vintage diagram of a lunar module buried in deep regolith, 1964

beats.text: In 1966, the Soviet Union's Luna 9 probe achieved the first soft landing.
beats.visual: Photograph of the Luna 9 spacecraft on the lunar surface, 1966

beats.text: NASA's Surveyor 1 followed months later, resting solidly on the firm lunar surface.
beats.visual: Surveyor 1 photograph of its footpad resting firmly on lunar soil, 1966

beats.text: Robotic scoops excavated trenches, proving the regolith could easily support a crewed lander.
beats.visual: Surveyor 3 surface sampler scoop digging a trench in the lunar soil, 1967

beats.text: But after sunset, Surveyor 7 captured a strange, unexpected glow along the horizon.
beats.visual: Surveyor 7 television image showing twilight horizon glow on the Moon, 1968

beats.text: Sunlight was scattering off razor-sharp dust grains levitating miles above the airless ground.
beats.visual: Artist concept of sunlight scattering off floating lunar dust grains, 2005

beats.text: This grit is electrostatically charged as the Moon passes through Earth's magnetic tail.
beats.visual: NASA diagram of Earth's magnetotail interacting with the Moon, 2008

beats.text: The real lunar hazard was actually floating in the sky.
beats.visual: Apollo 12 lunar module Intrepid standing on the sunlit Moon, 1969
